cover_prompt: Full-color illustration of a majestic underwater mermaid kingdom with warm cozy fantasy aesthetic. A beautiful kawaii mermaid princess with large expressive eyes and flowing ornate hair decorated with pearls and starfish, sitting on an elaborate coral throne inside a grand palace hall made of iridescent shells and sea glass. Foreground shows a mosaic floor of colorful sea tiles, treasure chests spilling pearls and gems, and friendly seahorse guards. Midground features towering coral columns carved with ocean motifs, jellyfish lanterns glowing softly, and schools of tropical fish swimming between the pillars. Background reveals arched palace windows looking out to a vibrant coral reef city with shell-roofed towers, sea turtle silhouettes, and shafts of turquoise light filtering from above. Rich color palette of teals, corals, lavenders, golds, and soft pinks. Premium fantasy underwater aesthetic, lush and inviting. Coloring Book for Adults. NO text in the image.
